other_conditions: The parent must be a registered construction worker with the Chhattisgarh Labour Department.
The registered construction worker (parent) must have died within one year of registration with the labour board.
Only the first two children of the deceased registered construction worker are eligible.
Children are ineligible if any other registered construction workers (parents) are present in the family besides the deceased worker.
benefits_summary: Eligible children receive benefits under the Naunihal Scholarship Scheme, Meritorious Students Education Incentive Scheme, and Technical Education Scheme.
